prediction.rationale:

Valve: severe lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.96 s (within 2% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.56 s (3% above healthy). Substantial delay in circuit pressurization confirms delayed spool actuation in the main valve.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.35 l/min (3% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 391 W·min/l (2% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 55.9 % (5% below healthy). High power-to-flow ratio demonstrates extensive internal leakage across the pump chambers.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 46.5 bar (within 1% of healthy). Elevated pressure ripple across working lines indicates moderate degradation of accumulator pre-charge.

tslm_prediction.rationale:
Cooler: reduced efficiency. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 40.1 °C (29% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 44.6 °C (24% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 46.9 °C (20% above healthy). Moderate fluid temperature rise and diminished heat exchange indicate degraded cooler efficiency.
Valve: severe lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.95 s (within 2% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.57 s (3% above healthy). Prolonged pressure rise time and marked switching lag between pressure lines point to severe directional valve response lag.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.36 l/min (3% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 390 W·min/l (within 2% of healthy); SE system efficiency factor 56.5 % (4% below healthy). Motor draws full electrical power while circuit flow drops substantially, confirming internal fluid bypassing.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 46.5 bar (within 1% of healthy). Slight increase in pressure oscillations indicates reduced surge dampening capacity.
